name: MLLMGuard
description: MLLMGuard is a multidimensional safety evaluation suite for multimodal large language models, covering five safety dimensions (Privacy, Bias, Toxicity, Truthfulness, Legality) in both English and Chinese. It includes a bilingual image-text dataset, inference utilities, and a lightweight evaluator to provide rigorous and unbiased safety assessments.
reputation: A recent specialized safety benchmark for multimodal LLMs that is gaining attention in the research community, but is not yet a long-established standard.
notes: Includes text and image-based red teaming with human expert annotations; introduces GuardRank evaluator with higher accuracy than GPT-4.
